description: Permission containment rules for the zero-trust auditing pipeline. Defines trusted vs untrusted input sources, agent write boundaries, network access rules, and output safety constraints.

sandbox_hardening.description: Guidance for running Claude Code in an isolated environment to contain risk from malicious contract source.
recommended_setup: Run Claude Code inside a Docker container or GitHub Codespace with no outbound network except allowlist
Mount contracts/ as read-only volume inside the container
Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY via environment injection, not a file in the repo
Disable Claude Code's file system write access outside audit workspace paths
Use a dedicated low-privilege OS user account for the audit process
mcp_server_risks: Verify all MCP server URLs against the network_allowlist before registering
Do not register MCP servers that accept arbitrary user-supplied GraphQL/SQL queries without sanitization
Treat MCP server responses as untrusted input — validate schema before passing to agents
